canonical_name_vi: Topo động Thực tại–Giả tại–Bách Lâm Infinity

core: Reality equals actuality within the relevant scope
ModelOfReality is not identical to Reality merely by representation
ObservedSlice is not TotalReality without closure proof
GiaTai is an assumed represented or derived reality-state whose actuality is not yet established
Existence of a GiaTai object does not imply actuality of its referent
Reality plus capacity to represent alternatives entails at least one GiaTai candidate within the BL∞ operational frame

nodes.role: dynamic open possibility, reachability, representation and recombination field
formalizes, values and routes GiaTai/hypothesis objects

THUC_DINH.meaning: Begin from reality-anchored evidence/constraints and open candidate GiaTai states.

GIA_DINH.meaning: Begin from a GiaTai premise/world-state, expand consequences through BL∞, then return to Reality for evidence-based update.

transition_rules: GiaTai may be promoted to a supported or accepted model of actuality only through adequate evidence and scope discipline
A previously accepted model may be demoted to revised, superseded, conditional or conjectural status after valid conflict
Mode changes do not themselves constitute epistemic progress
Actuality is not rewritten by the status transition of a model
progress_condition: A pass counts as progress only when it creates an auditable evidence, model, GiaTai, scope, measurement, capability, negative-knowledge, provenance or risk delta.
falsification_surface: If a system has Reality but no capacity to distinguish or represent alternative states, the operational entailment Reality plus alternative-representation capacity -> GiaTai does not apply to that system
If fixed hierarchy predicts the system better than mode-dependent precedence across relevant cases, the dynamic topology must be revised
If GiaTai is treated as evidence or actuality merely by representation, the implementation violates BL-GTP
